def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers_all = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    dist = instance["distance_matrix"]

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = dist[depot][route[0]]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += dist[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        c += dist[route[-1]][depot]
        return c

    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for n in route:
            s += demands[n]
        return s

    def two_opt(route):
        n = len(route)
        if n < 4:
            return route[:]
        best = route[:]
        best_cost = route_cost(best)
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            for i in range(n - 2):
                a = depot if i == 0 else best[i - 1]
                b = best[i]
                for j in range(i + 1, n - 1):
                    c = best[j]
                    d = depot if j == n - 1 else best[j + 1]
                    delta = (dist[a][c] + dist[b][d]) - (dist[a][b] + dist[c][d])
                    if delta < 0:
                        cand = best[:i] + best[i:j + 1][::-1] + best[j + 1:]
                        cand_cost = best_cost + delta
                        best = cand
                        best_cost = cand_cost
                        improved = True
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
        return best

    def insertion_position(route, node):
        if not route:
            return 0, dist[depot][node] + dist[node][depot]
        best_pos = 0
        best_delta = None
        for i in range(len(route) + 1):
            left = depot if i == 0 else route[i - 1]
            right = depot if i == len(route) else route[i]
            delta = dist[left][node] + dist[node][right] - dist[left][right]
            if best_delta is None or delta < best_delta or (delta == best_delta and i < best_pos):
                best_delta = delta
                best_pos = i
        return best_pos, best_delta

    remaining = set(customers_all)
    routes = []

    # Seed routes with the farthest remaining customer, then greedily extend.
    while remaining:
        seed = max(remaining, key=lambda n: (dist[depot][n], demands[n], -n))
        route = [seed]
        remaining.remove(seed)
        load = demands[seed]
        current = seed

        while True:
            best = None
            best_key = None
            for n in remaining:
                if load + demands[n] <= capacity:
                    extra = dist[current][n] + dist[n][depot] - dist[current][depot]
                    key = (extra, dist[current][n], demands[n], n)
                    if best_key is None or key < best_key:
                        best_key = key
                        best = n
            if best is None:
                break
            route.append(best)
            remaining.remove(best)
            load += demands[best]
            current = best

        routes.append(route)

    # Improve each route internally.
    for i in range(len(routes)):
        routes[i] = two_opt(routes[i])

    # Inter-route repair: relocate customers when it reduces cost.
    moved = True
    passes = 0
    while moved and passes < 4:
        moved = False
        passes += 1
        r = 0
        while r < len(routes):
            if not routes[r]:
                routes.pop(r)
                moved = True
                continue
            route = routes[r]
            rl = route_load(route)
            best_move = None

            for idx, node in enumerate(route):
                prev = depot if idx == 0 else route[idx - 1]
                nxt = depot if idx == len(route) - 1 else route[idx + 1]
                remove_delta = dist[prev][nxt] - dist[prev][node] - dist[node][nxt]

                for t in range(len(routes)):
                    if t == r:
                        continue
                    trg = routes[t]
                    if route_load(trg) + demands[node] > capacity:
                        continue
                    pos, ins_delta = insertion_position(trg, node)
                    gain = remove_delta + ins_delta
                    if gain < 0:
                        key = (gain, idx, t, pos, node)
                        if best_move is None or key < best_move[0]:
                            best_move = (key, r, idx, t, pos, node)

            if best_move is not None:
                _, fr, idx, to, pos, node = best_move
                routes[fr].pop(idx)
                if fr == to and idx < pos:
                    pos -= 1
                routes[to].insert(pos, node)
                if not routes[fr]:
                    routes.pop(fr)
                moved = True
                break
            r += 1

    # Final internal cleanup.
    for i in range(len(routes)):
        routes[i] = two_opt(routes[i])

    # Remove any empty routes if present.
    routes = [r for r in routes if r]

    return routes
